page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a high-density compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM hypervisor technology. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system provides 256 GB of system RAM, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 2.0 GB per core tailored for compute-heavy parallel execution.

The instance delivers a robust network baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating rapid inter-node data transfer across cloud environments. It includes no local storage disks, requiring network-attached storage for persistent operational data. Additionally, this instance profile does not include discrete GPU accelerators.

From a hardware resource perspective, the instance provides high compute core density alongside a lean memory configuration. This design delivers qualitative cost efficiency for scale-out parallel tasks where processing throughput is preferred over memory capacity per core. Suitable workloads include high-performance computing simulations, software compilation, batch image processing, and distributed ETL jobs.
